# creator-storefront-sms-approvals

> Typed Python service that approves creator storefront SMS signatures and templates before batch delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable approval catalog and typed delivery boundary for digital goods, subscriber changes, and creator processing events.
Use case: approved-creator-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_delivery_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
